description.value: WhataFood! is a Brazilian street food restaurant inside the New Westminster SkyTrain Station, best known for its freshly-made pastéis—Brazil's crispy, golden fried pastries—offered in both savory and dessert varieties alongside Whatabites and an all-you-can-eat experience. The business grew from a festival market stall in 2017 to a permanent storefront that opened in 2020, building a loyal following for its authenticity and warmth. Its transit-hub location makes it a quick and convenient food stop for cyclists moving through New Westminster.
